cohort.source: frozen official LIBERO-Plus pilot manifest; outcome-independent balanced subset

quantization.weight: symmetric signed RTN [-7,7], scales rounded to BF16 before encoding, packed nibbles
quantization.activation: dynamic symmetric signed per-row absmax/7, FP32 scales, RTN [-7,7], native packed S4
quantization.scope: all canonical unique target Linear modules in video_expert/action_expert/proprio_encoder
quantization.outside_scope: T5, VAE, norms, modulation nonlinearities, attention arithmetic, scheduler, bias and non-target parameters remain floating point

rotation.placement: matched local Linear-input right rotations xR and WR, after upstream normalization/modulation/nonlinearity
rotation.sharing: one R128 per video/action/proprio stream; incomplete blocks use static signed-Hadamard power-of-two tails
rotation.spinquant: same initialization, learned R128 = R0 @ Cayley(raw - raw.T); frozen original weights
rotation.adaptation_boundary: local R128 adaptation, not the published LLaMA global residual-R1 or full R1/R2/R3/R4 recipe; both arms use the same RTN quantizer

calibration.source: original LIBERO, independent of Plus evaluation observations

optimization.ste_arithmetic: The grouped fixed-input gate reference uses independent S8 x S8 int32 dot products per G128 group and FP32 scale/partial-sum accumulation; only Linear output is cast to input BF16 dtype; no TF32. The legacy dense FP32-dequantized STE result remains diagnostic and is not the native arithmetic reference.
optimization.packet_order: alternate video/action, seeded balanced permutations within each stream
optimization.loss: equal-weight mean normalized MSE at full video/action denoiser outputs versus frozen BF16 teacher on sampled fixed-input timesteps; original text context and recomputed proprio token; action packets use fixed teacher BF16 video KV
optimization.selection: minimum mean packet normalized MSE on four original selection cases among trained steps 40,80,120,160,200; earlier step breaks ties; step0 is diagnostic only
optimization.boundary: teacher-output distillation, not local Linear reconstruction, task-success tuning, full sampler unroll, or QAT of underlying weights

validation_reference.scope: preparation gate only; not installed in the closed-loop evaluation runtime and does not add to native counters
validation_reference.bank_coherence: On the allocated GPU, apply each original bank's online rotation and quantization to the BF16 target weights and require bitwise equality with the bank's packed values before the full-query comparison.
validation_reference.numeric_reference: For the same full-query inputs, compare real native S4 MMA with an independent S8 x S8 int32 dot reference computed per G128 group and accumulated using FP32 scales and partial sums.
validation_reference.legacy_dense_diagnostic: PBS job 25727738.pbs101 measured native-versus-dense-FP32-dequant-STE action RMSE 0.05439452, above 0.05. Dense dequantization followed by a whole-K FP32 reduction has different rounding from grouped integer dots and scale accumulation; this discrepancy alone is not evidence of a native kernel bug.
validation_reference.checkpoint_policy: Reuse the original selected step-200 rotation and both original banks; no retraining, reselection, or bank overwrite.

sequence: run.pbs after PREPARATION_COMPLETE and PREPARED gates pass
allocation.route: preparation: normal to gdev; formal evaluation: normal to g3

checks: online rotation and packed-bank bitwise coherence for both original banks
same-input grouped S8 int32 reference versus native S4 full-query gate

reporting.primary: paired closed-loop success counts/rates across the same 280 variants
breakdowns: paired discordant successes vs BF16 and fixed rotation
reporting.first_query: report first-query and subsequent-query timing separately
reporting.infrastructure_failures: missing slots, never counted as policy failures
reporting.completion: Preparation must pass PREPARED ready/numeric/native gates and PREPARATION_COMPLETE before evaluation submission; final completion requires 840 unique valid episode slots, each arm 280, each cell 10, aggregation complete, PBS Exit_status=0, and PIPELINE_COMPLETE from the evaluation job
